payload.posture: Read Acts 14:1–7 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states signs and division in Iconium. In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed. There they preached the Good News. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
